baseline.envelopes: 26/26 artifact digests verified; provenance and environment warnings remain

question: Can one declared HB-0 profunctor tendril causally update exactly one target worldlet under explicit caller authorization, while preserving endpoint routing, matched disabled and shuffled controls, and exact rollback on failure?

scope.identity_consolidation: out of scope; identity sections remain on their existing slow-clock path

frozen_transaction.commit_rule: commit y_star to exactly one selected target only when governance accepts active or shuffled mode
frozen_transaction.observation: preserve u, y, y_star, the full proposed and committed delta vectors, their norms, alignment residuals before/after, and cost
frozen_transaction.authorization: authorized_sources is caller-supplied; the transaction may not synthesize authorization from its own measured cost

primary_gates.statement: An accepted active transaction changes only the declared target, emits a non-zero committed delta vector, and decreases target-alignment residual.
The disabled control computes the same transport observation and cost but commits a zero delta to every worldlet.
The shuffled-target control leaves the declared target bit-identical and moves only the preregistered matched control target.
Missing compute authorization rejects the transaction and leaves all worldlet and identity state bit-identical.
A complex-valued chart output is rejected without casting away phase and leaves worldlets, tick, budget, and transaction ledger bit-identical.
Two kernels built with the same seed emit numerically identical transaction reports and post-transaction coordinates.

matched_control_requirements: All three routing modes use the same source snapshot, chart computation, coupling, target-carrier dimension, permeability, and tendril cost.
The shuffled target must differ from the declared endpoint while matching its carrier, local geometry, dimension, and permeability.
Disabled and shuffled modes may not bypass chart evaluation.
The declared target and all non-selected worldlets must be compared byte-for-byte before and after each transaction.
Identity sections are snapshotted and checked for non-mutation; their later consolidation is a separate preregistered slice.
kill_conditions: Any target coordinate is mutated before all endpoint, carrier, shape, finiteness, real-valuedness, coupling, control-match, and governance checks finish.
The implementation derives its own compute authorization from observed cost.
A complex output is silently projected to its real part.
Disabled mode avoids the chart computation or uses a different reported cost.
Shuffled mode mutates the declared target or uses an unmatched control target.
An exception leaves any worldlet, tick, budget field, or transaction-ledger entry changed.
The result is generalized to identity consolidation, task competence, cognition, quantum advantage, consciousness, or AGI.

evidence_floor.P: typed endpoint, staging, and rollback invariants enforced by code and tests
evidence_floor.M: the eight-seed deterministic simulated target-delta measurements
evidence_floor.H: whether active tendrils improve any held-out task or identity integration
evidence_floor.S: any broad claim about general intelligence or polycosmic cognition
evidence_floor.R: complex/hypercomplex carrier transport and phase-preserving identity consolidation

stop_condition: Stop after one real-carrier transaction primitive, the three matched routing modes, rejection and exception rollback controls, eight frozen seeds, an EvidenceEnvelope, focused and full regression, and a bounded result note. Do not add identity consolidation, global distance repair, or tunnelling reinterpretation in this slice.
